\[ \sum _\alpha H(X,Y_\alpha )= rac{(\sqrt{ au }-\sqrt{ au _1})^2}{(\sqrt{ ar au }-\sqrt{ au _1})^2}H(X). \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:div-ricci-scalar-curvature ↗ thm:curvature-evolution To prove the claim we sum Equation (Heqn) giving

I2(τ) ∑αH(X,Yα)

=

∑αH(X,Wα)

=

-▵R + 2\Ric (X,X) - 4\langle ∇R,X angle +4∑α(∇Wα \Ric )(Wα,X)

-2∑α\Ric τ( Wα,Wα) +2|\Ric |2 - rac{1}{ au }R.

Taking the trace of the second Bianchi identity gives

\[ \sum _{\alpha }( abla _{W_\alpha }\Ric )(W_{\alpha },X)= rac{1}{2}\langle abla R,X angle . \]

By (Revol), $\partial R/\partial au =- riangle R-2|\Ric |^2$, while differentiating $R=g^{ij}R_{ij}$ gives $\sum _\alpha \partial _ au \Ric (W_\alpha ,W_\alpha )=- riangle R$. Thus $I^2( au )\sum _\alpha H(X,Y_\alpha )=H(X)$.
